title: Fine-Grained Instruction-Guided Graph Reasoning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2503.11006v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision and Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to traverse complex environments by following natural language instructions, demanding accurate alignment between visual observations and linguistic guidance. To address these challenges, we propose a fine grained instruction guided graph reasoning framework (FIGR) that enhances both spatial representation and instruction understanding during navigation. Specifically, an observation graph interaction mechanism is introduced to disentangle angular and visual cues while strengthening directed edge representations through geometric embedding, enabling more reliable spatial reasoning within the navigation graph. The key detail guidance module is implemented as Adaptive Open Vocabulary Guidance (AOVG), where a contextual role parser dynamically identifies location, object, spatial relation, and other contextual cues. tldr: 提出细粒度指令引导图推理框架FIGR，通过观测图交互机制和自适应开放词汇引导（AOVG），增强了视觉与语言导航中的空间表示和指令理解能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes FIGR, a fine-grained instruction-guided graph reasoning framework that enhances spatial representation and instruction understanding in vision-and-language navigation through an observation graph interaction mechanism and Adaptive Open Vocabulary Guidance (AOVG).
